_stamp: [2026-10-24 09:07 PM Johnny Chu - Chu Hoàng Anh] PHASE-0.134 W1 (doc 20, R-TWIN-VAULT TV-0…9) — Twin Vault · Kho tri thức: the Markdown + YAML store of one site (tenant), every note traceable to its Journal row by source_ref. Runtime JSON (core/kg-hub/contracts): code = BizCity_Twin_Vault (+ BizCity_Brain_Vault_Store for files, BizCity_Journal_MCP_Tools::vault_get); docs/ is never read at runtime.
principle: Biến tài liệu, hình ảnh và thông tin thành những bản ghi có cấu trúc, dễ đọc, dễ liên kết, dễ chỉnh sửa và có thể truy vết về nguồn gốc.
format: Markdown + YAML frontmatter; frontmatter schema twin-vault@1 (brain-markdown@1 read as an alias)
storage: per tenant: library <uploads>/bizcity-skills/<blog_id>/ (same paths as the old skill library) + Vault Store <BIZCITY_VAULT_ROOT|uploads/bizcity-vault>/<blog_id>/<namespace>/ for readable copies of Journal rows

ids.src: src:TL-47 — the readable copy of one Journal row (also accepts TL-47@v2)

document.label: Tài liệu
document.from: Journal rows of layer document / output with a file

note.label: Ghi chú
note.from: common.note · common.instruction · task.minutes · grp.brief + library /note · /nhat-ky · /content · any other folder

routes.GET /tree: view=folders|types (default folders: roots + folders{home,list}); six roots by type
routes.POST /folder: label · icon? · access? (edit_posts; the site gives the next number 10-90)
routes.PATCH /folder/{nn}: label? · icon? · access? · rules{keywords[],groups[]}? · gurus[]? (access / gurus: owner only)
routes.POST /move: id · folder ("" = out of every folder); edit_posts; folder access gated both ways
routes.POST /note: id? · path? · title · markdown · frontmatter? · expected_updated? (edit_posts; 409 vault_conflict; 400 vault_path_refused for /skills · /tools)

mcp.vault.get: brain.read · content.read (ref TL-47 or id lib:/…)
mcp.vault.write: memory.write · write (notes only, never skills / readable copies)
mcp.vault.move: memory.write · write (only when the owner asks; never a skill)

folders.frontmatter_projection: materialized readable copies also carry group{gid,ref,name} · contact_id · folder from the Journal row (PHASE-0.136 S136-G6; the row stays the source)
folders.defaults_merge: a default whose number is free is added to a saved list on read (PHASE-0.136)
folders.aliases: ≤ 12 names per folder; vault.move / vault.write / vault.list accept a folder NUMBER or NAME (label / alias, folded, whole words, longest wins); unknown name ⇒ vault_folder_invalid

access.effect: owner: every row. staff: not rows of owner folders — tree, list, search, note (403 vault_folder_denied), graph, filing into it; brain-access decide() gives staff / automation / group_member nothing on a row filed in an owner folder
access.public: stored; no public door exists yet (a later phase)

folders.find: journal.find {folder} and context_scope.folder narrow only (prefix; disagreeing values ⇒ empty)
folders.rules: keywords (folded, whole words, ≤ 20) · Zalo group ids (≤ 10) ⇒ folder_suggest {n,label,icon,why[]} on an unfiled note / view=card; site code, no model; a person files it
folders.gurus: guru ids (≤ 10) ⇒ guru-context@1 scope.vault_folders (optional; etag unchanged when empty)
folders.stored: library note: frontmatter folder · Journal row: metadata.meta.folder (entry-meta@1, optional)

rest.POST /link: urls (≤ 5, array or one per line) · depth 0|1|2 (default 1) · folder? ⇒ {contract, depth, lines[{url, id, ref, entry_id, duplicate, status, error{code,message,hint,help_code}}]}; edit_posts; ≤ 20 new links / person / day (transient)

link_import.path: /link/<host without www>/<sha1(normalized url)[0:12]>.md — the same page is always the same note
link_import.frontmatter: source: web + web{url, host, from web|zalo, status pending|done|failed, depth 0..2, fetched_at?, parent_ref? LK-n, internal?, authority? 0..100, via? tavily_extract|tavily_map|fetch|jina, content_sha256?, links_found?, links_kept?, title?}; only from vault.write `link` (or kept from the note itself on an edit), never from a caller's frontmatter
link_import.row: kind common.link (LK-<entry id>), source_type web_upload (dialog) | owner_capture (Zalo), origin.surface web_link | zalo_link, card {vault_path, url, url_host, depth, parent_ref?, authority?, internal?}, derived_from [parent entry id]
link_import.states: the site writes the waiting note (meta.status pending); the cell reads the page and writes it back (status done / failed) — the site never fetches a page nor calls a model

delete._stamp: [2026-11-22 08:16 PM Johnny Chu - Chu Hoàng Anh] PHASE-0.153 S153-D1 — the one delete door of the Kho (one row, many rows, a whole web domain). Code: BizCity_Twin_Vault::rest_delete.

rest.POST /delete: ids: ["lib:/…" | "src:XX-n"] ≤ 200 ⇒ {contract, done, failed, lines[{id, ok, code?, message?, hint?, help_code?}]}; edit_posts; the acting owner's Kho only (V1b); 400 vault_delete_empty

delete.effect: library note ⇒ moved to /_trash/<path> (never listed: the scan skips names starting with _) + its Journal row voided; Sổ row ⇒ voided (history and the original file kept) + a web page's note moved to /_trash/; a website job still running ⇒ cancelled first (status skipped) so the cell stops; skills are refused (vault_delete_skill)
delete.revive: a note written again at the same path brings its voided row back (state captured)

site_crawl._stamp: [2026-11-22 06:57 PM Johnny Chu - Chu Hoàng Anh] PHASE-0.153 S153-C1 (doc 21, site-crawl@1.0.0) — học cả website. Code: BizCity_Vault_Link (rest_crawl_*), BizCity_Journal_Entry_Meta (crawl, crawl_want).

rest.POST /crawl: url (tên miền hoặc địa chỉ bất kỳ) · scope site|section · path? · limit 50|200|500|1000 (default 200, cap filter bizcity_vault_crawl_max_pages) · presets[login,cart,tag,search] · exclude[] · subdomains? · folder? · preview? ⇒ {contract, job}; one busy job per person (409 site_busy)
rest.GET /crawl[?active=1]: {contract, jobs[view], poll_s} — poll_s 15 while a job runs or a button waits, 0 = stop pulling
rest.GET /crawl/<entry_id>: {contract, job, poll_s}; 404 site_not_found when not the person's website job
rest.POST /crawl/<entry_id>/<pause|resume|can: writes meta.crawl_want only; exceptions: cancel of a queued job ⇒ cancelled now; recrawl / more of a finished job ⇒ queued again (status pending)

site_crawl.path: /link/<host>/_site.md — one website note per host in a person's Kho; its pages are link notes (link_import.path) with web.parent_ref = this row
site_crawl.row: kind common.link, card.web_kind = site, web.kind = site in the frontmatter
site_crawl.meta: entry-meta@1.2 additive: crawl {state queued|mapping|mapped|reading|paused|done|failed|cancelled, scope{host, path?, subdomains, exclude[]}, limit, found, kept, read, stored, failed, queued, dropped{junk,dup,over_limit,robots,external}, sections[{path,kept,stored}] ≤ 30, credits{est,used}, started_at, updated_at, finished_at, want_seen, resume_at, eta_s, last[LK-n] ≤ 5, error{code}, run, preview} — written by the cell after every batch; crawl_want {do, at, by} — written by the site; want pending = want.at > crawl.want_seen
site_crawl.jobs_index: user meta bizcity_vault_crawl_jobs = entry ids, newest first, ≤ 20 (no table, R-TABLE-FREEZE)
site_crawl.states: the site writes the waiting note (status pending, crawl.state queued); the cell (zalo-hub link-learn) maps (robots · sitemap · Tavily /map), reads in batches (Tavily /extract), writes pages and moves crawl.state — the site never fetches nor calls a model

journal: a vault.write opens / updates exactly one Journal row common.note (idempotency vault:<blog>:<md5(path)[0:24]>, source_type vault, card.vault_path); the site writes its source_ref into the frontmatter (TV-2, TV-3)
compat: REST bizcity/skill/v1 + window.skillAppConfig unchanged; skill files edited by the Steps editor; no file moved
